sourceWitness.zh: 按《元史》，至正十七年《授時曆》成。
sourceWitness.yuanShi52: 十七年冬至，曆成，詔賜名曰《授時曆》。

rationale: Chinese 至正 is the received Mingshi surface; literal English keeps Zhizheng. Yuan shi 52 and the Wang Xun–Guo Shoujing context fix the cited reign to Yuan Shizu 至元十七年; idiomatic English follows the reviewer correction to Zhiyuan without changing primary Chinese.

fields.literal: unchanged (renders received 至正 as Zhizheng)
